ns2:course.label: Tolstoy
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the major works of Lev Tolstoy. No Russian required. Same as CWL 323. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours, if topics vary. Prerequisite: One other college literature course or consent of instructor.
